description: A number on a dashboard is only half an answer. 9.7M in revenue — is that good? Against target, against last month, compared with the other countries? A plain card leaves the reader to work it out. KPI Card Pro puts the answer on the card: the value, its variance, the target, a trend line and a color that says on track, warning or off track. Add a category and the single card becomes a grid — up to fifty cards, one per country, product or team, each with its own figures and line. WHAT IS NEW IN 2.3 • Conditional formatting (fx) on the value colour and the card background, card by card in a grid • A single card that fills the visual: the number grows with it, like the native Card, until you set a size • Long card titles wrap onto two lines instead of being cut NO DATE TABLE, NO DAX Comparing against the previous period normally means a date table, DATEADD and one measure per KPI. Bind your date field to Trend and the card reads the comparison off the series it already draws: • Total of the period — the whole range • Latest point — December against November, or against the same month last year • Last N points — the rolling twelve months against the twelve before them The card prints what it compares — "Dec 2025 vs Nov 2025" — so the step back can be checked, not assumed. THREE KPIs BESIDE THE HEADLINE Sales 5.2M means little without margin, orders and average ticket. Up to three…
